title: DEWP Multi-Entry Evidence Bundle
description: A tenant-scoped, offline-verifiable bundle of Witness Events with a gapless tenantSeq commitment (dewp.audit.evidence-bundle).

version.description: DEWP specification version. Pinned: an unrecognised version must fail schema validation rather than be waved through as a plain string, which let a bundle claim any version at all.

kind.description: MUST be dewp.audit.evidence-bundle. There are no vendor-prefixed aliases (DEWP §6.5).

profile.description: Application Profile Extension identifier (DEWP §4.5), e.g. trust.intyga.audit.v1. Names the profile whose extra ordered fields follow DEWP Core in the canonical preimage.

howToVerify.description: Human-readable pointer to the verification procedure. Informational only — never load-bearing for verification.

tenantSequenceCommitment.description: The contiguous committed tenantSeq range this bundle asserts; verifiers reject gaps/duplicates/disorder within it. REQUIRED whenever any entry carries a tenantSeq, and omitted only when none does — a producer MUST NOT omit it for a bundle that has one.

tenantSeq.description: Per-tenant monotonic counter, carried on EVERY entry including redacted ones (DEWP §15 Commitment Preservation). Without it a redacted entry is invisible to the gapless check and lawful redaction reads as a phantom gap.

redacted.description: Convenience flag mirroring redaction.mode === COMMITMENT_ONLY, retained for consumers written against the older shape. `redaction` is authoritative.

anchorRef.description: Publication receipt for this root — a self-identifying commitment reference, written unconditionally at checkpoint time. NOT an independence claim.

anchoredAt.description: When the publication receipt was recorded (self-commitment time). Independence, if any, is carried by `anchors`.

entryCount.description: Committed events under this root. With prevChainHash, root, seqStart, seqEnd and anchoredAt it recomputes chainHash (DEWP §5.4).

prevChainHash.description: The predecessor checkpoint's chainHash; the empty string at the genesis checkpoint.

chainHash.description: This checkpoint's §5.4 chain hash. Every anchor in `anchors` binds it (DEWP §5.2); a verifier recomputes it from the fields above and refuses a checkpoint whose chain hash does not recompute.

anchors.description: Independent anchors over this checkpoint's root. This is the set the DEWP §5.3 quorum rule is evaluated over, so a bundle carrying only a single top-level anchor cannot express quorum.

externallyAnchored.description: Producer claim that a §5.3 external anchor quorum (distinct INDEPENDENT issuers — neither SELF nor WEBHOOK — >= the producer's configured requirement) exists for this checkpoint. Display/triage only — verifiers evaluate `anchors` under their own policy.

externallyAnchoredRequired.description: The quorum size the producer evaluated `externallyAnchored` against. Without it the boolean is unreadable: a 1-of-1 deployment and a 2-of-N deployment both publish `true`. A producer claim like the flag itself — it states what the producer required, not what a verifier confirmed.

numericSeq.description: Stringified 64-bit integer; MUST NOT be a UUID.

algorithmRegistry.description: DEWP §12 algorithm registry as emitted. Ed25519 is an ANCHOR algorithm (§14), not an event sigAlg, and is deliberately absent from signatureAlgorithms.

commitment.description: Retained commitment metadata for a COMMITMENT_ONLY entry: the original leaf hash MUST be preserved unchanged.
